meta_description: 37K likes, 641 comments - thefoodranger on August 28, 2026: "Trying the most Viral kebab shop in Athens @kiraristos ! This place has been showing up on my feed and I flew into Athens just to try it!!I gotta say it was totally worth the hype! The kebabs were so juicy and they make a signature bread bowl packed with kebabs, tomato, and yogurt. Not only that they also make delicious gyros and souvlaki! I would highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Athens! I will be back whenever I’m craving some delicious kebabs, wow they were so juicy! Where should we try next in Athens?".
